floater.name: floater_ss_atmo_match
floater.title: Match Sky from Photo
floater.text: Pick a photo, then drag a line up its sky starting at the horizon. Turn the camera toward the part of the sky you want matched - the markers show where - then press Match. Fits haze, the horizon gradient, and the cloud deck's colour and coverage.

spinner.name: top_elevation_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: How high above the horizon the top of your sample line is, in degrees. This is what maps the photo onto the sky - a line up a wide-angle shot covers far more elevation than one up a telephoto

floater.text: Pick a photo, then drag a line up its sky from the horizon.

button.name: match_button
button.tool_tip: Start fitting the sky to the sampled line
button.label: Match

button.name: stop_button
button.tool_tip: Stop here and keep what has been found
button.label: Stop & Keep

button.name: revert_button
button.tool_tip: Put the sky back exactly as it was before matching started
button.label: Revert
